title: Popful Mail (SNES) - Gadeth Ruins (Ruined Walls)
description:
A background seen very deep in the Guardess Ruins, from the Super Famicom version of Popful Mail. This background uses less than 14 tiles, meaning there is a lot of graphic space for foreground decorations. A good fit for ruins in a desert.

Credit would be great, but is optional.
